description: Source code for handling reaction-related API endpoints in Mattermost, including saving, retrieving, deleting, and bulk fetching reactions.

methods.name: InitReaction
methods.description: Initializes API routes for reaction operations (save, get, delete, bulk get).

methods.name: saveReaction
methods.description: Handles saving a reaction to a post, including validation and permission checks.

methods.name: getReactions
methods.description: Retrieves reactions for a specific post, with permission validation.

methods.name: deleteReaction
methods.description: Deletes a specific reaction, with permission validation.

methods.name: getBulkReactions
methods.description: Fetches reactions for multiple posts in bulk, with permission validation.
